$Comment: A goblin breach a quest summons with startWorldEvent (or startGoblinBreach). The pre-temple breach (Goblin_Breach_Prelude_Event) without its waits: it opens near the player whose quest started it, through the MysticQuestsPlayerLocation type, and runs until that pack is beaten. Vanilla's own pre-temple breaches stop for the whole universe once anyone powers the temple generator, so this is how a later player still gets one. The site carries the vanilla Goblin_Initial_Breach encounter, which sends goblin_initial_breach_cleared when its pack dies. Not persisted: a restart drops a breach still waiting to be found.
Name: server.worldEvents.goblinBreach.name
